data.long_meaning: From Old English ‘Eadweard’, ‘Ead’ meaning wealth and ‘weard’ meaning guardian. The name eddward carries the meaning “Wealthy guardian” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose eddward usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Έντουαρδος
